summary: Verified @noble/hashes yarn resolution pin (v1.8.0 installed) does NOT break the Univer spreadsheet engine, and validated the new SolutionReveal panel end-to-end on session 7b6958fc-e468-427a-b4cd-514ebe8d4cfd. Univer boots, Submit works, score banner shows, and the new 'Correct solution — see the finished model' panel behaves exactly per spec (reveal toggle, 5 solution rows Answers!B1-B5 with correct value/formula/pts columns). Dashboard smoke passes. No runtime/console errors introduced by the dependency change.

/session/7b6958fc-e468-427a-b4cd-514ebe8d4cfd/simulation loads the Univer spreadsheet; grid renders with FY15-FY24 data and toolbar. spreadsheet-submit-btn appears within ~5s (well under the 45s allotted).

console_observations: One benign React warning: 'Attempted to synchronously unmount a root while React was already rendering' — appears once on Univer boot. Non-blocking (Univer renders correctly). Same as prior baseline behavior — NOT caused by @noble/hashes pin.
WebGL GPU-stall performance warnings from headless Chrome — environmental, not app bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Yarn resolution pin '@noble/hashes': '^1.8.0' is correctly set in /app/frontend/package.json (line 112-114) and node_modules confirms v1.8.0 installed. Deployment fix is valid.

SolutionReveal component (UniverSpreadsheet.jsx L41-100) uses local state for toggle — good. It reads submitState.score.details which is the auto-scored per-cell breakdown, so no extra API calls needed.
Consider adding an aria-expanded on spreadsheet-solution-toggle for a11y (minor, non-blocking).
